inputs.string:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult person in <Picture 1>, with the exact face, skin tone, hairstyle, body proportions and complete outfit from that image: a photorealistic man in his late twenties with a lean build, warm olive-tan skin, hazel-brown eyes, defined dark eyebrows, a short, neat dark beard and moustache, small silver hoop earrings in both ears, and voluminous dark-brown curly hair falling over his forehead. He wears a loose cream textured-linen collarless shirt with long sleeves pushed up, worn open at the chest, two fine gold chain necklaces, dark-wash indigo denim jeans, dark leather cord bracelets on his right wrist and a gold band ring.
<Video 1> is the source clip; use its performer's motion, timing and camera movement.
<Audio 1> is the source soundtrack.

summary:
[reference generation] From the very first frame, <Subject 1> fully replaces the performer in <Video 1> and performs the same actions with the same timing for the entire clip.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: attribute_transfer - transfer the face, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions consistently to every frame.
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - preserve the performer's action, pose, timing and camera movement; do not preserve the original performer's face, makeup or face paint, hair, hair accessories, clothing or props.
<Audio 1>: reference - keep the timing and ambience of the source audio.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic, continuous shot.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1>, already fully transformed in the opening frame, starts half out of frame at the left edge and, at about two seconds, walks in toward the centre, glancing sideways and then turning to face the camera. From about three and a half seconds he starts dancing in place: he brings one hand up to his chest, shrugs, and swings his arms loosely, then from about five and a half seconds he leans his body to one side with both arms stretched wide like wings, swaying left and right with the beat. At about eight seconds he lifts one arm over his head with the hand behind his head and bends his torso sideways, then around nine and a half seconds he points his right hand straight toward the camera and finishes standing upright facing the camera. The camera stays static on a tripod-like handheld position with only a slight sway. The camera follows the same path and framing as <Video 1>. Stable face, stable outfit, natural body motion, no identity drift, no morphing, no duplicated limbs.
Setting in <Video 1>: the target video takes place in <Subject 2>, an outdoor rooftop terrace in daytime in front of a large, dense, leafy green mango tree that fills the upper frame, with a low concrete ledge topped by a dark metal railing behind, sloping corrugated and tiled rooftops with blue plastic tarpaulins on the left, and a pale, uneven concrete and stone floor in the foreground.
Scene lighting on the performer in <Video 1>: soft, even, overcast daylight from above with no hard shadows, neutral-white colour temperature, natural green-dominated colours and a bright, slightly flat exposure.
Framing on the performer in <Video 1>: static wide shot; the performer is partly cut by the left frame edge for the first two seconds, then shown from the top of the head to about the shins in the centre of the frame, with the feet mostly cut by the bottom edge.

overall_soundscape:
Light outdoor ambience with faint wind and distant background noise, and a brief sharp sound near the start. No invented dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
